definition.simple: Mixing two different types of plants to make a new, better plant that has the good qualities of both.
definition.academic: The process of crossing two genetically dissimilar individuals to produce a hybrid with desired characteristics.

examples: Crossing a high-yielding wheat plant with a disease-resistant wheat plant.

common_misconceptions: Students think hybridization only happens in a lab. It can also happen naturally or in a simple farm by transferring pollen.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student what happens if they mix red paint and blue paint, and apply that analogy to plant traits.
